description:
**This is an amendment to the below offer. The purpose of the amendment (Amendment 2) is to provide an addendum to Section L, updated PWS, and updated Price Schedule. The document with answers to vendors' requests for information is posted.** 

 This is an offer for a to provide MRRIC Chair professional services, in close coordination with MRRIC, the lead agency, and one or more meeting facilitators. Services include supporting the diverse Committee members as an impartial leader in enabling members to articulate their underlying interests and perspectives and help the Committee formulate consensus-based recommendations to the lead agency as it relates to the USACE MRRP and assist the USACE in planning and leading constructive MRRIC engagements per the Performance Work Statement (PWS)
